Name: Meshify
Description: Sets the number of vertices used to construct the mesh facets. Higher values produce finer, more detailed meshes; lower values create larger, more pronounced facets.

Name: Vertices
Description: Sets the number of vertices used to construct the mesh facets. Higher values produce finer, more detailed meshes; lower values create larger, more pronounced facets.

Name: Seed
Description: Randomization seed for mesh facet arrangement. Changing the seed produces different polygonal patterns and facet layouts.

Name: Detail Sensitivity
Description: Controls how closely the mesh facets follow the underlying terrain detail. Higher sensitivity preserves more terrain features; lower sensitivity results in smoother, more abstract faceting.
